procedure_name: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act)
summary: Legal registration of marriage under Hindu Marriage Act 1955 or Special Marriage Act 1954.

steps.title: Compile couple's documents
steps.description: Age proof (matriculation certificate/passport), address proofs, joint wedding photographs, and wedding card.
documents_needed: Age & Address proofs of bride and groom

steps.title: Submit application on e-District portal
steps.description: Fill online marriage form, enter particulars of 3 witnesses, and book appointment slot.

steps.title: Physical appearance before Marriage Officer
steps.description: Couple and 3 witnesses appear before SDM/Registrar to sign official marriage register.

steps.title: Issuance of Marriage Certificate
steps.description: Download government Marriage Certificate bearing official seal and registration number.
